rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something firmly and without changing your mind.

example.english: I unwaveringly support you and won't change my mind.
example.traditional: 我堅定咁支持你，唔會改變主意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 ding6 gam3 zi1 ci4 nei5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3

rows.jyutping: ngaan5 dou1 m4 zaam2 gam3 V
rows.note: Use this for an unwavering visual action, especially staring or looking without blinking.

example.english: They stared unwaveringly at the camera.
example.traditional: 佢眼都唔眨咁望住個鏡頭。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ngaan5 dou1 m4 zaam2 gam3 mong6 zyu6 go3 geng3 tau4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on maintaining the same attitude or action consistently over time.

example.english: They unwaveringly remain on our side.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci2 zung1 kei5 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ni1 bin1
